hypothesis: A state-restoration mechanism qualified on one reaching-task joint intervention generalizes without adding task-specific reward history to other physical interventions and tasks.
null_hypothesis: At least one independently varied seed, intervention variable, or task causes unequal untreated replay, unequal treated replay, failed intervention, or control contamination.
purpose: One bounded infrastructure generalization screen before prioritizing learned cognitive integration; not evidence of transferable learned cognition.
sequence: Control A, restore same checkpoint control B, treated A, restore treated B, restore final untreated control C
stop_condition: First failed control replay, invalid intervention, no physical effect, failed repeated treated replay or contaminated final control.
acceptance: All four cases pass exactly; only source-only simulator substrate qualification, not independent scientific first-use, learned architecture integration or transfer.
policy_next: If any negative, retain it without tuning, and redirect effort to task-agnostic memory state design. If positive, stop further simulator qualification and proceed to source-free learned-mechanism integration readiness for Wingless/Yggdrasil.
